PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 10.0, 25.0),      # front CS device gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "Iext":  (6e-6, 0.5e-6, 15e-6),   # extra CS current via resistor top-up load
    "gmid3": (14.0, 8.0, 22.0),       # follower gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),
    "Ifol":  (12e-6, 4e-6, 18e-6),    # follower current (resistor sink)
    "Rf":    (430e3, 380e3, 600e3),   # feedback resistor
    "Cf":    (1e-15, 0.1e-15, 20e-15) # feedback cap (peaking/stability control)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1 = iref + p["Iext"]
    Rf, Cf, Ifol = p["Rf"], p["Cf"], p["Ifol"]

    # ---- DC: vin = vout = Vgs1 (no DC current in Rf); x = vout + Vgs3
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.1)
    vout = m1.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Ifol, vds=VDD - vout, vsb=vout)
    vx = vout + m3.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vx)       # re-size at real vds
    vout = m1.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Ifol, vds=VDD - vout, vsb=vout)
    vx = vout + m3.vgs
    RL = max(vout, 0.05) / Ifol                               # follower sink resistor
    Rld = max(VDD - vx, 0.05) / p["Iext"]                     # CS top-up load resistor

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # CS front stage; IREF (into ibias) is the active load at node x = ibias
    n.dev("M1", "ibias", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.R("RLD", "vdd", "ibias", Rld)
    # in-loop source follower driving CL
    n.dev("M3", "vdd", "ibias", "vout", "vss", m3)
    n.R("RL", "vout", "vss", RL)
    # feedback network
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", Cf)

    # ---- small-signal nodal model (nodes: in, x, out)
    gm1, gds1 = m1.gm, m1.gds
    cgd1 = m1.cgd; cgs1 = max(m1.cgg - cgd1, 0.0); cdd1 = m1.cdd
    gm3, gmb3, gds3 = m3.gm, m3.gmbs, m3.gds
    cgd3 = m3.cgd; cgs3 = max(m3.cgg - cgd3, 0.0)
    Cin = cpd + cgs1
    Cx = cdd1 + cgd3
    Cout = cl + m3.cdd * 0.3
    gx = gds1 + 1.0 / Rld
    go = gds3 + 1.0 / RL

    def zt(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
        Y = np.array([
            [s * Cin + s * cgd1 + yf, -s * cgd1, -yf],
            [gm1 - s * cgd1, gx + s * (Cx + cgd1 + cgs3), -s * cgs3],
            [-yf, -gm3 - s * cgs3, gm3 + gmb3 + go + s * (Cout + cgs3) + yf]
        ], dtype=complex)
        v = np.linalg.solve(Y, np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=complex))
        return abs(v[2])

    z0 = zt(1e3)
    f3db = 1e10
    for f in np.logspace(4, 10, 800):
        if zt(f) < z0 / math.sqrt(2.0):
            f3db = f
            break

    # ---- noise at 1 MHz (referred to the iin node as a current)
    k4T = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = k4T * 0.8 / gm1 + (k4T / Rld) / gm1**2
    yin2 = (w * (Cin + cgd1 + Cf))**2 + (1.0 / Rf)**2
    in2 = k4T / Rf + en2 * yin2
    in_noise = 1.1 * math.sqrt(in2)          # margin for 1/f + follower

    power = VDD * (iref + p["Iext"] + Ifol)
    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(z0), "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout, "in_noise_1m": in_noise}
